ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RT-4,
Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District; B1-1, Neighborhood Shopping
District; B3-1, Community Shopping District; and C1-1, Neighborhood Commercial!
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-F in the area bound by:

West 111" Street; a line 105 feet west of and parallel to South Eggleston Avenue; the
alley next north of and parallel to West 111th Street; the alley next west of and parallel to
South Egglestone Avenue; a line 124.96 feet south of and parallel to West 110" Street,
a line 156 feet east of and parallel to South Normal Avenue; West 110" Street and
extended where no street exists; the east right-of-way line of the Chicago and Western
Indiana Railroad; West 111" Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South
Princeton Avenue, the alley next south of and parallel to West 111" Street and extended
where no alley exists; South Lowe Avenue; a line 135 feet south of and parallel to West
411" Street; South Union Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West 111"
Street; and South Emerald Avenue,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
